Administer Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies, connector governance, and environment access controls in line with governance standards set through AEP and GHD’s information security policies. Manage Entra ID groups, licensing assignment, and role-based access for Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Agent 365, and related Power Platform services. Operate the Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE) toolkit, including tenant-wide visibility, maker inventory, compliance reporting, and agent usage analytics. Partner with Microsoft Purview owners on sensitivity label enforcement, information protection, and compliance across agent touchpoints. Serve as the first point of escalation for platform-level issues raised by makers, delivery teams, and the program manager, driving fast resolution of environment and connector blockers. Maintain documentation of platform configuration, standards, and runbooks, and contribute to the onboarding of new makers and agent developers across GHD. Support audit, risk, and compliance reviews relating to AI agent deployment, providing evidence of controls and attestations as required. What you will bring to the Team: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 5 or more years of experience administering Microsoft 365 or Power Platform in an enterprise environment, with at least 2 years focused on Power Platform and Copilot or agent-related workloads. Demonstrable experience operating Power Platform DLP, environment strategy, and connector governance at scale. Microsoft certifications strongly preferred: PL-200 Power Platform Functional Consultant; PL-500 Power Automate RPA Developer or PL-900; MS-102 Microsoft 365 Administrator; SC-400 Information Protection Administrator is valued. Working knowledge of Entra ID (Azure AD), including group-based licensing, conditional access concepts, and service principal management. Demonstrable experience with Data Loss Prevention policies, connector classifications, and environment-level guardrails in Power Platform. Familiarity with Microsoft Purview, information protection, sensitivity labels, and the interplay between Purview and Copilot grounding. Competence with the Power Platform CoE Starter Kit, admin analytics, and tenant-level monitoring tools. Operational discipline: strong ticket hygiene, incident and change management awareness, and a bias toward repeatable, documented operations. Service mindset with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and business users, and to translate platform constraints into practical guidance for makers. Comfort working in a fast-moving AI product landscape, with the judgment to apply controls proportionate to risk rather than blanket restriction. new_matches.title: Maintenance Lead
new_matches.description: We are Reckitt Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege. Supply Our supply chain is the backbone of our business. It's how we get our trusted products to people all over the world, safely and efficiently. And it's our talented and passionate teams that make this happen. If you're looking for a career in supply chain, there's no better place to be than Reckitt. We offer a variety of exciting opportunities in all areas of the supply chain, from planning and procurement to manufacturing and logistics. You could join our Global Supply Planning team to develop and implement our global supply strategy, or work with our Procurement Centre of Excellence team to negotiate and manage our supplier relationships. Our Manufacturing Excellence team help us improve the efficiency, quality and safety of our manufacturing operations, and our Logistics Excellence team develop new and innovative ways to distribute our products to customers. About The Role As a Maintenance Lead , you will play a key role in ensuring equipment reliability, performance, and compliance within a regulated OTC Health environment. You will lead all engineering and reliability activities within the cell, working to achieve zero breakdowns, eliminate recurring losses, and maintain equipment in a validated and compliant state. You’ll partner closely with Cell Leads, Process Leads, Quality, Validation, and Engineering teams to deliver improvements in CAPEX, safety, quality, and productivity. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, requiring strong problem-solving capability, reliability expertise, and the ability to coach and upskill team members. Location: Nottingham, NG90 - On Site Duration: Permanent, Full Time Recruiter: brenna.borghisanilevy@reckitt.com Hiring Manager: Simon Elrick Your responsibilities Breakdown Elimination & Reliability Improvement Own the cell Breakdown Elimination (BDE) system and lead root‑cause analysis for major losses. Drive sustainable countermeasures using structured problem‑solving tools. Develop and maintain equipment reliability strategies to reduce unplanned downtime. Analyse failure data and loss trees to prioritise improvement initiatives. Ensure technical standards and critical spares strategies are maintained. Maintenance Planning & Scheduling Lead maintenance planning and scheduling for the cell. Build and maintain preventive maintenance plans aligned to equipment criticality. Ensure effective weekly maintenance schedules and material readiness. Track PM compliance and quality of execution. Zero Loss Mindset Champion the IWS Zero Loss journey within the cell. Eliminate chronic equipment losses impacting SQDCS metrics. Translate loss intelligence into improvement plans. Engineering Support to Projects Provide engineering input to CAPEX and productivity projects. Support URS development, design reviews, FAT/SAT, and commissioning. Ensure maintainability and reliability are built into new equipment. Capability Building & Coaching Train and coach team members in CIL, defect handling, and basic condition monitoring. Build technical capability to enable operator ownership of equipment. Standards, Compliance & Safety Ensure compliance with GMP, EHS, and engineering standards. Own engineering risk assessments and permit‑to‑work systems. The experience we're looking for Qualified engineer or equivalent relevant technical experience. Strong background in maintenance planning, scheduling, and equipment reliability. Experience in a regulated environment (GMP/GxP highly desirable). Knowledge of TPM/IWS principles and maintenance excellence frameworks. Proven root‑cause analysis capability and experience reducing equipment losses. Strong coaching and leadership skills with the ability to influence across teams. Ability to interpret data, analyse trends, and translate insights into action. Experience supporting engineering projects, commissioning, or CAPEX delivery. Strong commitment to safety, compliance, and process discipline What we offer With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy. Equality We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'.
